title: Hypervest
tagline: Hyper1nvest is your crypto investments co-pilot — DCA, TWAPs, and advanced 1inch-based strategies.
description:
Hypervest is an automated crypto investment platform built on Arbitrum that enables users do strategic performing investments without adding emotions or manual intervention.
The platform integrates 1inch Protocol to provide swaps and execute these strategies like - DCA, TWAPs, Buy the Dip, Momentum etc.

All users need to do is connect their wallet, deposit funds for allowance, and directly choose strategies!
how_its_made:
Frontend: React + TypeScript with Vite, using wagmi for wallet connections
Backend: Node.js + Express + TypeScript with Prisma ORM
Database: PostgreSQL 
Blockchain: Arbitrum network integration
Partner Tech: 1inch Protocol for DEX aggregation

We had to hack a few things we had to create a Master wallet which receives the users deposits and ends up acting as a relayer for 1inch token approvals and transactions and in the end it transfers the funds back to users. 

User ends up depositing to our master wallet and after confirming we let the user make the trades with the deposited cap.
